scope: Owned source-grid contract for partial-rule rectangular cell ownership; production and whole-paper fidelity remain unproven.
invariants: Every physical row covers each source grid column once.
Vertical continuation has the same start column and width as its preceding owner.
Source text from all vertically merged rows appears in the restart cell only.
Native row fonts, sizes, colors and positions use the full merged source region.
Each atomic source border is retained without added edges.
Per-owner source text validation rejects repeated-word loss and values swapped across cells.
